title: Battle Presentation Layer Refactor
summary: Behavior-preserving split of the client battle presentation layer: staging.ts god-file into staging-seed/staging-fx (one consolidated EffectLoop + HitStop)/move-fx data module, shared battleUI.ts deduping spar-vs-cup screen logic, one disposeObject3D utility, CSS class-ownership cleanup with mock.css scoped under .mock, and small a11y additions (cup modal focus trap/Escape/aria-modal, aria-pressed fast-forward, focus restore).
